findings.quote: A smooth surface, such as a mirror, sends parallel rays out in one direction.
findings.problem: General statement that fails on a known exception. It holds only for a smooth flat surface. A smooth curved mirror does not send parallel rays out in one direction: a concave mirror sends them to one focus point and a convex mirror spreads them. The follow-on lesson the student reads next (Mirrors and Lenses) teaches exactly that, so the two lessons contradict each other on their face. The sentence is not new from the fix; earlier rounds did not raise it.
